question: Should CodexBar surface active Neuralwatt subscription kWh alongside prepaid USD credits, or intentionally define this provider as balance-only?
rationale: The official response exposes separate usable quota pools, and the branch intentionally omits one; tests cannot decide the user-facing product contract.

options.title: Show both quota pools
options.body: Add a subscription kWh metric alongside prepaid credits so the UI reflects all currently usable Neuralwatt quota.

options.title: Accept balance-only semantics
options.body: Explicitly approve prepaid-credit-only tracking and document that active subscription capacity may not be represented by the primary status.

options.title: Pause the integration
options.body: Keep Neuralwatt unregistered until the quota contract and real-account verification are available.

recommendation.title: Show both quota pools
recommendation.body: Add a subscription kWh metric alongside prepaid credits so the UI reflects all currently usable Neuralwatt quota.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the carried hardening commits and recorded the unresolved quota-model recommendation on the related branch.
